product_overview: A comprehensive EdTech platform that provides role-based student and instructor portals, specialized domain learning modules (UPSC, RAS, Ancient Wisdom, Graphotherapy, Meditation), gamification and management dashboards. Key capabilities and test scenarios are documented across the PRD pages (see pages 1–4) including routing, RBAC, and Pomodoro/Evening Session behaviors.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based authentication with role-based access control (RBAC) and feature flags to surface only authorized dashboards and modules.
Deliver specialized learning modules (Batch 1, Batch 2, RAS, Graphotherapy, Meditation) with robust content delivery, timers, and revision tools.
Support instructor and admin workflows with isolated management portals for course creation, cohort management, analytics, and announcements.
Ensure reliable student learning experience: discovery, video playback, assessments, study utilities, certificates, and gamification triggers.
Offer resilient communication systems (forums, live classes, notifications) and meet non-functional requirements for accessibility, performance, and graceful error handling.

features.name: User Login
features.description: Allow users to authenticate with email and password and be routed to dashboards appropriate for their role/feature flags.
user_flows: Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See appropriate dashboard or landing page for user role
Navigate to /login -> Fill email input field with incorrect email -> Fill password input field -> Click Login button to submit -> See login error toast or inline validation message

features.name: User Registration
features.description: New users can create accounts (Student or Instructor) via the registration page and receive verification or onboarding flows.
user_flows: Navigate to /register -> Fill email input field -> Fill password input field -> Complete additional registration fields -> Click Register button -> See email verification prompt or welcome onboarding screen
Navigate to /register -> Fill email input field with already-registered email -> Fill password input field -> Click Register button -> See validation error indicating email already in use

features.name: Batch 1 Evening Session (Pomodoro Timer)
features.description: Students with Batch 1 access can open the Batch 1 portal, start the Evening Session Pomodoro timer, and receive progress and gamification rewards upon completion.
user_flows: Navigate to /(student-portal)/student/batch1 -> Click Evening Session -> Click Start Pomodoro Timer -> Observe UI countdown and session progress indicator -> Complete Pomodoro session -> See session summary and coins/achievement awarded

Navigate to /(student-portal)/student/batch1 -> Click Evening Session -> Click Start Pomodoro Timer -> Encounter timer synchronization error or fetch failure -> See error boundary with retry option or skeleton loader error message

features.name: RAS Portal and PYQ Viewer
features.description: Authorized RAS students can access the RAS-specific portal to view syllabus, previous-year questions (PYQs), and take MCQ tests with tracking.
user_flows: Navigate to /ras -> Click PYQ Viewer -> Select a PYQ set -> Click Start MCQ Test -> Answer questions sequentially -> Click Submit Test -> See results and session analytics
Navigate to /ras -> Click PYQ Viewer -> Attempt to open PYQ set without feature flag access -> See access denied or subscription gate message and prompt to contact support or purchase access

features.name: Meditation Portal
features.description: Students can open the Meditation dashboard, play multimedia sessions, and have session progress recorded without interruptions.
user_flows: Navigate to /meditation -> Select a meditation session from the dashboard -> Click Play -> Observe media playback controls and session timer -> Complete session -> See progress recorded in profile
Navigate to /meditation -> Select a meditation session -> Click Play -> Encounter multimedia playback error or network failure -> See retry control or offline message and preserved session state

features.name: Admin Portal - Global Settings & Announcements
features.description: Admins can access an isolated admin dashboard to manage global settings, announcements, and system configuration.
user_flows: Navigate to /(dashboard)/admin -> Authenticate as admin -> Click Global Settings -> Edit announcement content -> Click Save -> See success toast notification and updated announcement visible to target cohorts
Navigate to /(dashboard)/admin -> Authenticate with non-admin account -> Attempt to open Global Settings -> See access denied message or redirect to appropriate dashboard
